text.offer: Castle Victoria was the seat of kings, once. Now its halls are full of the walking bones of Far'Nohl's court. I'd see the place cleansed - start with fifteen of the skeletons in its halls, and we'll talk about what lies deeper.
text.progress: The skeletons walk the halls of Castle Victoria and the rooms upstairs.
text.complete: Fifteen. The castle is a little quieter. But Far'Nohl's guard still holds the upper rooms.
